reason: Autoconf Archive ax_* source macros retain GPL terms; the exception covers generated configure output, not redistribution of the raw macro under arbitrary terms. Selected builds consume existing CMake/release configure and do not regenerate Autoconf. SDL pkg.m4 has a broader distribution exception but is also unused and removed with the unused m4 directory.
retained_license_choices: APR config.guess/config.sub/ltmain use explicit distribution exceptions; HIDAPI selects permissive alternatives; HDF5/netCDF generated Bison parsers retain explicit larger-work exception. No blanket assertion that all exception texts are equivalent.
regeneration_guard: configure_local.cmake passes --disable-maintainer-mode because upstream defaults maintainer mode ON. Numeric conversion M4 inputs and m4 executable remain required.
